scope: Official first-party documentation and one official linked entry shell; normal web capabilities only; no current account access validation; no current trend counts.

sources.title: How to use Trends
verified_claims: Creative Center Trends displays trending hashtags by industry.
Instructions include login, industry/time-frame filtering, and hashtag analytics.
Analytics includes trendline, related videos, audience insights, regional popularity and related hashtags.

sources.title: About Creative Center
verified_claims: Creative Center is publicly accessible; login is recommended to see all features, data and insights.
The currently retrieved Trends section says trending hashtags.
Top Ads is a separate collection of high-performing ad creatives.
sources.search_body_discrepancy: Search result for an older version said April 2025 and hashtags, songs, creators and videos by region/industry. Actual opened body said July 2026 and only established trending hashtags. Current body was used; removal of older features was not inferred.

sources.title: TikTok One Creative Suite
verified_claims: The linked entry redirected and exposed Top Ads, Trends, creative-tools navigation and a Log in button to the web reader.

sources.title: New Features on Instagram Reels: Trends, Editing and Gifts
read_sections: Find Out What's Trending on Reels
Making It Easier to Edit Reels
verified_claims: The 2023 announcement describes a Reels destination for trending songs, audio-use counts, and trending topics/hashtags.
Reels watch-time insights described there concern the creator's own content, distinct from a market trend count.
sources.interpretation_limit: iOS/Android wording appears in the editing section and is not evidence that the trends destination is available on desktop web.

sources.title: Reshape Your Instagram With a Recommendations Reset
read_sections: Ways to Shape Your Instagram Experience
verified_claims: Explore, Reels and Feed recommendations personalize over time based on content and accounts with which the user interacts.
sources.analysis_inference: An observed recommendation feed is a personalized sample, not evidence of a complete US trend ranking or fixed-window growth.

sources.title: How can I see what's trending on Reddit?
verified_claims: Activating the search bar shows some of Reddit's most searched things from the last few hours.
Selecting a topic leads to related top posts, communities and people.

sources.title: What filters and sorts are available?
verified_claims: Post sorts include Relevance, Hot, Top, New and Comment Count.
Hot prioritizes recent engagement; Top prioritizes high upvotes/comments; New prioritizes recency.
Search time filters include all time, past year, month, week, 24 hours and hour.

sources.title: What's the difference between r/all, r/popular, news and my home feed?
verified_claims: On Reddit.com, Popular is a feed of popular posts, whereas Home is based on joined communities.
sources.analysis_inference: A popular-post feed is distinct from the search-frequency topics documented in R1 and from a keyword-volume time series.

sources.title: Reddit Pro Feature: Trends
read_sections: Top keywords related to your keyword
verified_claims: Smart keywords support post/comment mention volume over a selected period and change against the previous period; standard keywords do not have those enhanced insights.
Related keyword metrics use six-month periods.
Coverage is selected public SFW English conversations, not all Reddit and not restricted by country/region.
The FAQ limits downloading other users' posts/comments and other Pro information; own organic-content metrics are treated separately.
not_established: whether the user's topics are smart keywords
sources.analysis_inference: English conversation volume cannot be reported as US-only demand.

sources.title: What is Reddit Pro?
verified_claims: Reddit Pro is a free beta suite for eligible businesses and organizations.
It is available on desktop/mobile web; the Trends tab is also available on native mobile apps.
Availability is in English-speaking countries where Reddit operates.

sources.title: X Trends FAQ
read_sections: Can I see Trends for a specific location?
verified_claims: Trends are available on x.com and identify topics popular now using an algorithm.
Default trends are personalized; users can select a specific trend location.
Post count is one ranking factor, related tags may be grouped, and some trends show approximate associated-post counts.
Selecting a trend opens search; searches can be filtered for quality.
not_established: current US option and account access

sources.title: How to use advanced search
verified_claims: Advanced search is available while logged in to X.com.
Search can be refined by words, people, places and dates, including a date range.
not_established: historical trends ranking or total volume

research_limitations: This is capability research, not completion of four-platform trend measurement.
Search snippets were not accepted when actual official page text differed.
No old failed consumer-post URL or CUA path was retried.
No account login, enrollment, publication, message or supplier action was performed.
No capability absent from the reviewed documents was asserted globally nonexistent.
Current browser state is intentionally not copied; use the project-state pointer.
